content.short: Treasure is a crypto-native game publisher connecting games and players together through MAGIC tokens.
content.description: Treasure has nurtured a thriving, intimate network of builders and players who share a passion for play. The project aims to reshape game publishing by building a decentralized gaming ecosystem. It rests on three core pillars: Games — created from the ground up by Treasure and seasoned builders, all linked by MAGIC; Community — a composite of many smaller communities connected through lore, guilds, resources, and MAGIC; and Infrastructure — the shared economic engine, tooling, and resources that power the ecosystem and empower builders to create, collaborate, and grow.
content.meta: Treasure is a crypto-native game publisher connecting games and players through MAGIC tokens. Discover Treasure and other DAOs on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
